steps.content: The ship's doctor bandages Milly's hand before sending Sallie back to work. Sallie wants to stay, but can't find an excuse.

Milly doesn't look like she wants to talk. For the first time, the woman always as bright as the sun has lost all traces of her smile. Her eyes are vacant, like a gaping abyss. She sits stiffly in the dressing room, quiet and still, in a space filled with a cold, dead silence.

There's no way she can work like this. The doctor seems ready to report her condition. Sallie paces anxiously, slipping away when she finds a chance. She runs into Cassian at the doorway. They gaze at Milly, who still sits frozen, lost in a black hole of time.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: What's... the matter with her?

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: You and Milly go way back. You must know something. Why don't you fill me in? So I can comfort her...

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: You're worried about her?
Sallie gives him a withering look. Cassian shows no hint of mockery; he only toys with his finger chain in silence.
After a few seconds, he finally relents.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: You know Milly has a lover, right?
Of course she knows. The man who holds a special place in Milly's heart... her hero, her love, her dream.
steps.female_content: Of course she knows. The woman who holds a special place in Milly's heart... her hero, her love, her dream.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Why are you bringing that up? Don't tell me...
Then it dawns on Sallie: he's the subject of the guests' gossip—the MBCC Chief.
steps.female_content: Then it dawns on Sallie: she's the subject of the guests' gossip—the MBCC Chief.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: In a place like this, you have to find something to hold onto. If you don't, you'll go insane, or turn into some mindless beast they have to put down.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: It's not my place to tell Milly's story. We all came here for different reasons, but we meet the same end...
He pauses, his gaze drifting down the long hallway.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: You think she's an idiot, don't you?

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Well... at first I did, but now I...

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: It's fine. She is an idiot. She was sold to the lowest rungs of the Syndicate.
Fear runs through Sallie as she remembers her own ordeal in Eastside. Milly, then... Cassian could see what she's thinking.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: In the Syndicate, she was another face in the muck. No one cared what she looked like. It wasn't until she got here that Mr. E spent the money and time to dress her up into what you see now.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: See that blond hair? To the gang, Milly was just a good luck charm. They bought her for good fortune, dragged her to every business deal, called her a Sinner who could bring wealth. And when they didn't get rich, they beat the hell out of her.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: She tried to run many times. Each time, they dragged her back and beat her worse. Eventually, she couldn't run anymore, just survived on her sad, B-class ability. Back then, all she could do was numb those who touched her, so they wouldn't hit her quite as hard.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: ...So that's why she loves that person so much. The hero of Syndicate. But that place has been liberated. How did she end up here...?

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: Some people are just born unlucky. That's all there is to it.
They fall silent.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: Right before the West District was fully liberated, before she could finally be free... the gang sold her off to the desert bandits for one last score.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: Later, Mr. E found her when he was going around looking for weak Sinners. He bought her cheap, grew her talent... and turned her into the Jewel of Euphoria.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: The reason she's held on this long... is probably because in those dark Syndicate days, she really did see a hero.
Backstage, Sallie gently knocks on the door before stepping inside. She finds Milly, who's curled up in a ball, and crouches down beside her.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Milly... were you crying?

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: It's just hearsay. It might not even be true. Maybe it's just a rumor the Chief put out to throw them off.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: ...Do you really love him that much? You've never even met, or spent any time together.
steps.female_content: ...Do you really love her that much? You've never even met, or spent any time together.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: We did meet once...
Milly finally speaks, her voice slow and choked with tears.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: He's good. He's great. He's the best person I've ever met.
steps.female_content: She's good. She's great. She's the best person I've ever met.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Everything I'm doing here... is so I could be by his side. I want to be like him. I want to become a good person, like he is.
steps.female_content: Everything I'm doing here... is so I could be by her side. I want to be like her. I want to become a good person, like she is.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: If he's gone...
Milly's voice trembles as she trails off. Sallie grasps her hand, trying to give her strength.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: You're already a good person, Milly.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: You've been helping me this whole time, haven't you? Where I used to work, back in Eastside, the girls always said to watch out for love. That it can make you lose yourself, make you think you can't live without someone.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: But that's not true. You can live without anyone. When one person leaves, another one will come along to love you. At least... in here, I really, really want you to be okay.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: You were going to help me escape, remember? When we get out of here together, so many more people will love you. You'll see a bigger world, sing on bigger stages!

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: A bigger world...?

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: What do you mean?

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Huh?

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: He's the best person in the world. I don't need anything else.
steps.female_content: She's the best person in the world. I don't need anything else.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: What if he never comes? Are you just going to wait forever? What if he really is dea—
steps.female_content: What if she never comes? Are you just going to wait forever? What if she really is dea—

steps.content: Milly's grip tightens on the gray doll, and Sallie cuts herself off. After a long silence, Milly speaks quietly.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: That won't happen...
[Footsteps]

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: Don't bother. Mr. E is much better at brainwashing than you are. He's been filling her head with nonsense for years to keep her under his control.
Cassian is leaning against the doorway.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: She didn't have your luck. She never went to school, never saw the world outside. What you're talking about... are things reserved for the fortunate.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: Those born unfortunate can't even see the path to change their fate.
He walks closer and crouches down, so Milly can look directly into his eyes.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: Milly, I have good news. You'll want to hear this.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: I've found Theodore's address. Unfortunately, he's away on a trip. But he's expected to be back in two weeks.
He turns to look at Sallie.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: Wait a little longer. When he's back, I'll let him know you were sold to this place. I'll arrange a meeting.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: ...Really?
A glimmer of light shines in Milly's eyes. Even in her grief, she still feels happy for her friend.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Did you hear that, Sallie? Your love is coming for you. He's going to save you from this place.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: It's true. Everything will be alright. And your love will be fine, too.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: Good people don't die that easily, right?

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Ah... that's right... I can't stay down in the dumps forever. Sallie needs me. I have to pull myself together!
She pushes herself to her feet and pats her cheeks. Her pale face brightens with that brilliant smile again, just like when she takes the stage.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Come on, Sallie. We still have a lot to do.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Don't you worry about a thing. Trust Cassian. And trust me, okay? Mr. E won't do anything to me. The worst he can do is lock me up for a little while.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: But then you'll be all alone...

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: It's okay. Waiting isn't hard.
She cuts Sallie off, as if to bolster her own courage.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: ...It's not so hard, when you have something to believe in.
